bundle.shortDescription: Your agents' markdown, under your control.
bundle.longDescription: Folio is a local, single-user markdown workshop for the files your agents read and write: documentation, prompts, task lists, and skills. Automatic versioning without git, agent edits that arrive as reviewable proposals, artifact intelligence, and anchored comments agents can read and address.
